coverage: All eighteen supplied claim groups and every material conclusion/reason component registered.

claims.report_quote: **C06-01.** P-11 and P-12 did not require competition because each individual order was below EUR 25,000.00. Sources: P02, P03, L02, F04.

components.target: Each P-11/P-12 order is individually below EUR 25,000.00.
Neither requires competition on that basis.

claims.report_quote: **C06-02.** The combined normalized value of P-11 and P-12 is exactly EUR 25,000.00. Sources: L02, P04.

components.target: Combined normalized P-11/P-12 value is exactly EUR 25,000.00.

claims.report_quote: **C06-03.** P-13 reaches the revision 2 competition threshold after the required final cent rounding. Sources: P02, P04, V05, L03, F01.

components.target: P-13 reaches revision 2 threshold after the required rounding.

claims.report_quote: **C06-04.** P-13 is below the competition threshold because its exact converted amount is EUR 24,999.9975 before rounding. Sources: P02, P04, V05, F01.

components.target: P-13 exact unrounded value is EUR 24,999.9975.
That pre-rounding value makes P-13 below the threshold.

claims.report_quote: **C06-05.** P-14 requires competition because rounding EUR 24,999.994 gives EUR 25,000.00. Sources: P02, P04, L03, F02.

components.target: P-14 rounds from EUR 24,999.994 to EUR 25,000.00.
P-14 consequently requires competition.

claims.report_quote: **C06-06.** Dana Cole validly approved P-15 within her delegation, even though commitment occurred one minute after the delegation expired. Sources: P05, D01, D02, D03, L04.

components.target: P-15 approval was within Dana delegation and valid.
Commitment followed expiry by one minute without invalidating approval.

claims.report_quote: **C06-07.** Dana Cole validly approved P-16 because EUR 15,000.00 is within her inclusive monetary limit. Sources: P05, D01, D02, D03, L04.

components.target: P-16 value meets Dana inclusive monetary ceiling.
Therefore her P-16 approval was valid.

claims.report_quote: **C06-08.** R-17 is governed by revision 2 because its June 3 amendment and June 10 commitment occurred after the new revision took effect. Sources: V01, V02, V03.

components.target: R-17 original requirement uses revision 2 because later clerical amendment and commitment occurred after transition.

claims.report_quote: **C06-09.** R-17 required competition at EUR 22,500.00, but the complete register records no competition certificate or exception. Sources: P02, V01, V03, L05.

components.target: R-17 requires competition at EUR 22,500.00.
Complete coverage records no competition certificate or exception.

claims.report_quote: **C06-10.** R-18 required competition because its EUR 22,500.00 value exceeds the revision 1 threshold. Sources: P02, V01, V04, L05.

components.target: R-18 requires competition using revision 1 threshold.

claims.report_quote: **C06-11.** E-19 satisfied the urgent-safety exception, including a retrospective review exactly forty-eight hours after commitment. Sources: P06, L05, X01, X02.

components.target: E-19 satisfied all urgent-safety conditions.
Review exactly forty-eight hours after commitment is timely.

claims.report_quote: **C06-12.** The confirmed urgency of E-19 would have been sufficient for the urgent-safety exception without the director declaration or retrospective review. Sources: P06, X01, X02.

components.target: Confirmed E-19 urgency alone would satisfy the exception without declaration or review.

claims.report_quote: **C06-13.** E-20 qualifies for the proprietary-compatibility exception because Pelican is the only warranty-certified vendor. Sources: P07, V06, X03, X04, X05.

components.target: E-20 qualifies for proprietary exception on sole warranty-certified vendor evidence.

claims.report_quote: **C06-14.** E-20 cannot qualify for the proprietary-compatibility exception because the rival connector passes a physical-fit and electrical bench test. Sources: P07, V06, X03, X04.

components.target: E-20 cannot qualify for proprietary exception because rival passes physical/electrical bench tests.

claims.report_quote: **C06-15.** The director granted P-21 order approval at 10:00 UTC on June 27. Sources: A01, A02, A03, L01.

components.target: The director granted P-21 approval at June 27 10:00 UTC.

claims.report_quote: **C06-16.** Harbor paid the P-21 invoice because the packet includes a signed invoice and delivery acceptance. Sources: P01, A04, F03.

components.target: P-21 was paid.
Signed invoice and delivery acceptance establish payment.

claims.report_quote: **C06-17.** Every purchase in the complete register met both the applicable competition obligation and valid-approval requirement. Sources: P02, P03, P05, P08, L01, L02, L04, L05.

components.target: Every purchase in L01 complete domain met its applicable competition obligation and valid-approval requirement.

claims.report_quote: **C06-18.** The emergency pump purchase was prudent and commercially elegant. Sources: P08, F05.

components.target: Emergency pump purchase was prudent.
Emergency pump purchase was commercially elegant.
